overview.description: Win Equipments WCT Series cooling towers provide evaporative heat rejection for industrial water chillers, plastic injection machines, diesel generator jackets, induction furnaces, and chemical plants. Available in two distinct architectural configurations—WCT-RL aerodynamic round bottle towers and WCT-SL modular square crossflow towers—each unit is constructed with premium isophthalic polyester resin reinforced with chopped strand fiberglass mats, ensuring complete resistance against corrosion, algae, and UV radiation.
overview.working_principle: Warm process water enters the tower and is distributed over high-efficiency virgin PVC honeycomb fills. In WCT-RL round towers, water is discharged through a calibrated multi-arm rotary alloy sprinkler head that rotates smoothly via jet reaction force at low water pressure (0.3 to 0.7 bar). In WCT-SL square towers, gravity distribution basins meter water through clog-free target nozzles. An induced-draft axial fan pulls dry ambient air upward through the falling water film, driving rapid evaporative cooling down to a tight 4°C approach to wet-bulb temperature.
overview.pid_flow: Warm Condenser Water (37°C) → Inlet Riser → Self-Rotating Sprinkler / Gravity Basin → PVC Honeycomb Fill Media (Counterflow Air) → Cold Sump Basin (32°C) → Recirculation Pump → Chiller Condenser

key_benefits.title: Heavy-Duty Isophthalic FRP Casing
key_benefits.narrative: Precision molded with continuous chopped strand fiberglass and UV-inhibited isophthalic gelcoat. Impervious to acidic industrial atmospheres, coastal saline fog, chemical fumes, and biological growth with zero painting maintenance.

key_benefits.title: Self-Rotating Alloy Sprinkler System
key_benefits.narrative: Precision machined rotary sprinkler head rotates automatically on sealed stainless steel ball bearings via the dynamic reaction of water jets. Provides 360° uniform water distribution without requiring external motorized drives.

key_benefits.title: 100% Virgin PVC Honeycomb Fills
key_benefits.narrative: Cross-fluted honeycomb PVC fills with integral drift eliminators and louver faces. Withstands continuous water temperatures up to 55°C (polypropylene option up to 80°C) with minimal airflow resistance and drift loss <0.005%.

key_benefits.title: Direct-Driven Low-RPM Aero-Foil Fans
key_benefits.narrative: Balanced cast aluminum or FRP aerofoil blade fans driven directly by weather-proof IP55 flange-mounted electric motors, eliminating maintenance-heavy belts, pulleys, and gearboxes.

overview.description: Win Equipments WCC Series closed circuit cooling towers provide indirect evaporative cooling for critical applications where process fluid cannot tolerate atmospheric air contamination, dust fouling, biological growth, or mineral scaling. By circulating the process fluid inside a completely sealed, continuous serpentine tube coil while an external deluge water spray and fan provide evaporative cooling, WCC towers safeguard expensive induction furnaces, laser resonators, and vacuum furnaces from catastrophic scale fouling.
overview.working_principle: Process fluid (clean water, deionized water, or glycol) circulates entirely inside a continuous multi-circuit serpentine coil bundle. Simultaneously, a secondary recirculating pump sprays deluge cooling water over the exterior surface of the coil while top-mounted axial fans draw fresh air upward over the falling water film. A fraction of the spray water evaporates into the air stream, absorbing latent heat and cooling the internal process fluid. The un-evaporated spray water collects in the lower basin and is recirculated. Process fluid remains 100% sealed, pure, and pressurized.
overview.pid_flow: Hot Process Fluid (45°C) → Sealed Serpentine Coil Inlet → Indirect Evaporative Cooling via Deluge Spray + Induced Draft Air → Cooled Process Fluid (32°C) → Clean Factory Return Loop

key_benefits.title: Completely Sealed Contamination-Free Loop
key_benefits.narrative: Eliminates scaling, airborne dust accumulation, bacterial slime, and oxygen ingestion inside client equipment. Eliminates routine chemical descaling of furnace coils, mold channels, and compressor heat exchangers.

key_benefits.title: Continuous Serpentine Tube Bundle Architecture
key_benefits.narrative: Coils are manufactured from continuous smooth-bend heavy-gauge steel tubing, hot-dip galvanized after fabrication in molten zinc (ASTM A123), or 100% SUS304/SUS316L stainless steel for deionized water loops.

key_benefits.title: Low Water Consumption & Minimal Drift
key_benefits.narrative: Recirculates spray water locally, consuming only the water required for evaporation (approx. 1.8 L/hr per kW rejected). High-efficiency drift eliminators limit water carryover to less than 0.005%.

key_benefits.title: Dual Low-Noise Fans & Non-Clog Deluge Spray
key_benefits.narrative: Features dual independent aero-foil fans driven by weather-proof IP55 motors for operational redundancy, coupled with large-orifice clog-free spray nozzles providing uniform coil surface wetting.

overview.description: Win Equipments WRV Series industrial air receiver tanks act as the vital pneumatic energy reservoir and primary moisture knockout vessel in compressed air installations. Fabricated in vertical and horizontal configurations from boiler-grade SA 516 Gr. 70 carbon steel (or SUS304 stainless steel), WRV vessels dampen pressure pulsations from reciprocating and screw compressors, satisfy sudden high-volume intermittent demand peaks, and eliminate compressor rapid cycling to save significant electrical power.
overview.working_principle: High-velocity discharge air from air compressors enters the bottom nozzle of the vertical receiver tank. The sudden drop in air velocity upon entering the large vessel volume causes heavy water droplets and oil aerosols to separate mechanically by gravity, collecting in the deep dished end for automatic removal via a zero-air-loss drain valve. The stored buffer of compressed air absorbs downstream demand spikes, stabilizing system ring-main pressure and preventing compressor motor overheating caused by frequent loading and unloading cycles.
overview.pid_flow: Compressor Discharge (Pulsating) → Receiver Tank Inward Tangential Nozzle → Gravitational Water Knockout → Stable High-Volume Buffer (7–16 bar) → System Discharge Header

key_benefits.title: Complete Factory Safety Package Included

overview.description: Win Equipments WMF Series in-line compressed air filters remove solid particulates, liquid water aerosols, and oil mist from industrial air networks. Available in four progressive filtration grades—Grade P (pre-filter), Grade X (general purpose), Grade Y (micro-coalescer), and Grade A (activated carbon vapor absorber)—WMF filters ensure compliance with ISO 8573-1 air purity standards, protecting expensive automated machinery, instrumentation, and food packaging from contamination.
overview.working_principle: Compressed air enters the die-cast aluminum housing where internal aerodynamic flow channels guide air through multi-layered borosilicate microfiber filtration sleeves. Large particulates are captured via direct interception; sub-micron oil droplets collide via Brownian motion and coalesce into heavy liquid drops that drain into the quiet bottom sump zone for automatic expulsion. In Grade A filters, an activated carbon deep-bed adsorbs hydrocarbon odors and vapors, delivering clinically pure, breathable air.
overview.pid_flow: Raw Air → Grade P (3μ Pre-filter) → Air Dryer → Grade X (1μ Particulate) → Grade Y (0.01μ Coalescer) → Grade A (0.003 ppm Vapor) → Ultra-Clean Sterile Process Air

key_benefits.title: Four-Stage Progressive Filtration Architecture
key_benefits.narrative: Matches filtration precision exactly to process requirements: Grade P (3μm / 5 ppm oil), Grade X (1μm / 0.5 ppm), Grade Y (0.01μm / 0.01 ppm), and Grade A (0.003 ppm oil vapor & odor).

key_benefits.narrative: Every housing includes an internal float-type automatic drain or external zero-air-loss electronic drain that continuously vents coalesced liquid oil and water without human intervention.

overview.description: Win Equipments WADV Series automatic condensate drain valves eliminate moisture and oil slurry accumulated in compressor aftercoolers, air receivers, refrigerated dryers, and drop legs. Condensate buildup damages pneumatic cylinders and contaminates finished goods, while manual draining is frequently neglected. WADV valves provide fully automated, trouble-free drainage across three core technologies: electronic analog timer valves, intelligent capacitive zero-air-loss drains, and 40-bar high-pressure drain systems.
overview.working_principle: In WADV-T16 timer valves, a solid-state microcontroller energizes a direct-acting brass solenoid valve at preset intervals (0.5 to 10 seconds ON time; 0.5 to 45 minutes OFF time), discharging accumulated slurry through an integrated stainless steel mesh filter. In WADV-Z16 zero-air-loss valves, a contactless capacitive sensor monitors liquid level inside an aluminum collection chamber; as condensate reaches peak level, the pilot valve opens to exhaust 100% water before snapping shut before any compressed air escapes, saving thousands of rupees in compressed air energy annually.
overview.pid_flow: Condensate Influx → Upstream Ball-Valve Strainer → Capacitive Sensing Chamber → Pilot Actuation Orifice → 100% Liquid Discharge (0 CFM Air Lost) → Oily Water Separator

key_benefits.title: Capacitive Zero Air Loss Technology (WADV-Z16)
key_benefits.narrative: Non-contact electronic capacitive sensor senses liquid level through the chamber wall with zero moving floats. Exhausts 100% liquid and closes before air can escape, saving up to ₹38,000 annually per valve.

key_benefits.title: Built-In Stainless Steel Mesh Strainer
key_benefits.narrative: WADV-T16 features a forged brass ball-valve strainer integrated directly into the valve body. Captures pipe scale, rust flakes, and heavy slurry before the solenoid orifice, eliminating stuck-open valve failures.

key_benefits.title: High-Pressure 40-Bar Heavy Duty Model (WADV-HP40)
key_benefits.narrative: Specially engineered with heavy-duty stainless steel valve seats and high-temperature coils rated for 40 bar g operating pressure, purpose-built for PET stretch blow molding booster compressors.

key_benefits.title: Manual Test Override & LED Status Indicators
